verdict.rationale: HumanLayer lets you run its stack and remote daemons on your own workstation, cloud VM, or private-network machine, so execution can be self-hosted (humanlayer-docs-31, humanlayer-docs-7, humanlayer-docs-27). The control plane still appears to be hosted, though: tasks are controlled from app.humanlayer.com and automation sessions are described as Cloud-visible (humanlayer-docs-2, humanlayer-docs-12). Missing for 10: documented self-hosting of the control plane/web app, a fully offline or air-gapped deployment path, and independent hands-on corroboration.
